question: Before Challenger, a chart showed only the damaged flights. Where did the 16 undamaged ones fall?
answer: Warm days: every one at 66°F or above. So all four flights launched below 65°F came back with damaged seals, against 3 of the 19 warmer ones. Charted with the failures alone, the cold looked harmless. Challenger flew the next morning, colder than any launch before it.
move: Before you decide something doesn't matter, look at the times nothing went wrong.
trap: Spread out, since flights without damage seem to say nothing.

web.label: A chart of seal damage on seven shuttle flights by launch temperature, with the 31°F forecast far to the cold side. You say where the sixteen undamaged flights fall, then they drop into place.
